rv.q: It's a warm-centered production that delivers all that this title promises.
“In the Heights” overflows with heart and heat, the tropics of the DR merging with the baked asphalt of the Heights to deliver a sizzling story rooted in history and as relevant as today’s headlines.
To get straight to the point: This is a show that is not to be missed.
You will find yourself deliriously swept away by the music, directed by Ryan T. Nelson and conducted by Noah Landis, and the nonstop exuberance of William Carlo Angulo’s choreography...
This production is a bit unusual for Marriott, which tends to stage classic musicals like last year's Damn Yankees and the theatre's next play, The Music Man .

The warmth and charm of all these Latino characters, including a brilliant chorus of actors/singers/dancers, tirelessly carry the show, warm up the winter night and drive this excellent production all the way up to the Heights.
Following these and other stories to their sometimes bittersweet conclusions is an exhilarating night at the theater.
Besides that, the production of In The Heights was phenomenal, which is one of the reasons I love going to Marriott Theater.
No hay duda de que, con paciencia y fe, los clientes de Chicago disfrutarán de Marriott's In the Heights durante todo el invierno.
Both Marriott and Miranda have done better work; wait for that.
Marriott Theatre's production is superb and should be on your "TO SEE" list!
Marriott's 'In the Heights' is a fun, touching, beautiful masterpiece!
“In the Heights” is a celebration of life, hope and working to make your dreams a reality.

cn.t: Critics praise this vibrant production for its joyful energy and celebration of community, with Miranda's pre-Hamilton musical feeling fresh and relevant. Strong performances and staging deliver on the show's heartwarming promise.
